lines: Never ends, ah
Never ends
Never ends
Past midnight, the lingering afterimage blurs
Your words and smile pass by
A sheet lies upon my stretched-out body
What touched softly
was your love
What could I have done for you
The wounds I caused and the promises I couldn't keep
tear my chest
Even the push of this standing‑still back
and the halting of my restless heart
were always the voice that called me
I want to hold your body and its warmth
turning into a helpless night
softly, yearning for you so I won’t vanish
If I could return to that day
If I could stay by your side forever
Would our now be any different
Oh, within the swelling waves of memory
Words that seem about to spill out
I swallowed them and simply exhaled
The pathetic feeling after telling a lie
Nights when I couldn’t be gentle
The one person in this world that wrapped me
I want to hold your body and its warmth
so that the helpless night won’t fade
Never ending, never wavering, never letting go, the light you gave
My one and only you, whoa
Never ends
Ah, ah-yeah, ah-yeah
